scope: paper-only research forecast generation, immutable ledger, evaluation and owner read; no real trading

methodDetails.fiveDay: Synthetic no-trade data; five actual acquire, empty-intent settle, mark, commit and sidecar; session clock fixed for maturity; actual evaluator and owner comparison
methodDetails.paging: 22 synthetic copied records plus one engine-generated record; actual SQL page 3 and year selection
methodDetails.sidecarFailure: synthetic SQL error injected at sidecar INSERT after actual commit; paper revision and cycle persist
methodDetails.witnessRace: actual SQL witness captured, synthetic competing evidence inserted before append; append rejected

limitations: No production completed evaluation or real orders verified
Five-day E2E uses empty intents, not five days of actual buy and sell executions
Concurrent evidence test uses controlled interleaving, not a production race
Forecast calibration and profitability are not established
User GET is read-only; forecast jobs write the research ledger
cleanup: Synthetic databases dropped; dedicated network-none container stopped and removed; private fixture retained separately
